notes.notes:
We’ve just fixed the Mauser HSc reloading animation!
The manual states that the slide should automatically drop when inserting a new magazine, so now it works exactly that way in the game.

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: CZ 457 Rifle — Progress Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5944041/399860e9b9edabf172504c1d797720d451897fd0.jpg
We are currently preparing the CZ 457 rifle for release, and here is what has already been completed:

Disassembly / Assembly


 Corrected sounds
 Corrected arrows
 Fixed animations
 Field strip added


Operation


 Suppressor added
 Picatinny rail added
 Optic scope added
 Original sounds added
 X-ray set up
 Parts named according to the original manual
 Animation fixes


The last step before release is texture creation.
We plan to share the texture creation process with you via a live stream on Patreon next week — stay tuned!

👉 Early access to the CZ 457 rifle will be available through our Patreon.

notes.title: HK G11 Update: Nearing the Finish Line!
notes.notes:
Dear World of Guns users!

We’d like to share an update on our progress.

We’ve been working hard to finish and release the HK G11 as soon as possible. Here’s the current status:

    Operation mode – completed
    Disassembly/assembly and field stripping – completed
    Textures – completed

What’s left: we need to finish the cutaway view and operating gases. Our plan is to release the HK G11 into Early Access next week and fully release it by the end of the week!

Here are some pictures of the model.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5944041/a78a47c3099f8ced4bfc2ac0e9d86e7ec6b2c078.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5944041/bc402be05b6a92407feb8b592539c2b52aad227d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5944041/266739bddb62af6eaae20b4ac7f8fd9d16a2eb10.jpg

We hope you’ll enjoy it! The HK G11 is truly unique with its internal mechanism, and we’re planning a stream to explain its mechanics in detail.

Best wishes,
The NE Team

notes.title: World of Guns: Gun Disassembly recent update
notes.notes:
We've made an update several days ago and it worth to tell more about it.

What we've been doing over the last few months:
- UI improvement in game modes: disassembly/assembly progress indicator (green line under model name) - it helps a lot when the part flies out of the field of view during animation, or when a user has doubts if the part has finished its animation or not)
- UI improvement in game modes: during disassembly/assembly animation parts are highlighted with orange shading (no pulsation) - very helpful in hardcore mode
http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/animation_ui.jpg
- 10 music albums have been added
http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/music_alb.jpg
- Slovak localization added (work in progress)
http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/sk_lang.jpg
- All localizations are updated (Chinese [traditional], Polish and Swedish are still in progress)
- UI improvement (Animation Speed-Up On/Off icon, Autofocus On/Off icon have been added to Game mode)
http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/anim_on.jpg
http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/autofocus_on.jpg
- Daily puzzle updated (we added the possibility to gain +1 life for 10 right answers in a row)
- Multi-platform mechanism added. You may merge accounts from Facebook, Android, stand alone version, etc. ( in the game go to Account, Manage Account-Merge Accounts)
http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/accounts_merge.jpg
- HD textures for models announced (check progress on the community forum)
- DEMO modes have been added (Game Demo, Super Game Demo, Hardcore Demo and Cinematic demo(circled playing of all unlocked models one by one))
http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/cinematic_demo.jpg
 - Optimization and bug fixes

Thank you for your support!

NE team

notes.title: Steam Workshop update!
notes.notes:
We've just released new version of World of Guns.
Steam Workshop has been updeted!!
What's new!
In the PAINT mode for each model user can download sets, which have been submitted by other users.
When downloading new sets user may sort items by:
Top Rated, Most Subscribed, Most Recent  and Subscribed, All

Also all items has rating in the left upper corner.

http://noble-empire.com/images/workshop.jpg

User may subscribe to the item. All subscribed items will be automatically updated, however it's not required to be subscribed to item to download it.
http://noble-empire.com/images/subscribe.jpg

We hope you will like new features!

Dev Team
